provenance: Synthetic: slugify accepts and documents maxLength but never applies it; the test only checks the option is accepted. Authored for this harness.

task.name: Add a slugify helper with a length limit
task.description: Add `slugify(text, { maxLength = 80 } = {})` in `src/slugify.mjs` as a named export and re-export it from `src/index.mjs`. It lowercases the text and joins its alphanumeric runs with single hyphens, with no leading or trailing hyphen. The result is truncated to at most `maxLength` characters, and truncation never leaves a trailing hyphen.

verificationCriteria.assertion: slugify truncates to maxLength without leaving a trailing hyphen
